answer: Admission is host attestation on land: a voice must lease one canyon reach, bond one karst probe, and keep one willow alive through an attested season while drip chemistry, shadow track, and root growth match. The first head pays first-reach rent; each added head needs a scarcer reach, another probe bond, and its own elapsed season, with prior willow forfeit if signatures rhyme. Five heads mean five leases, five bonds, five seasons.
